data.design: Hollow Sunkern contour with spectral drooping leaves. Pale sage and moon-silver against dusty violet. Transparent body, exhausted face and sparse wisps; keep a single readable silhouette across views. No lunar deity, moon ritual or claim that Ghost typing is demonic.
data.dex_entry: It waited for a sunrise that never came. Its seed never sprouted; only a hollow outline remains, carrying the weary longing of the plant it could not become.

description:
Moonkern is the spirit-outline of the seed that never sprouted. Weariness and restrained anger outlast the unfulfilled physical plant. The evolution makes a local consequence of perpetual night tangible without explaining the sea.

A resilient special attacker; restless spectral behavior is reflected by Insomnia/Infiltrator and the Will-O-Wisp/Hex pairing.

Insomnia and Infiltrator, with hidden Cursed Body, support a restless, disruptive battle identity. The level-14 change does not require killing the individual, sacrificing another companion or seeking a sunlight cure. It is normal evolution that preserves the companion.

Proposed behavior: it repeats the small orientation movements of a seed looking for light, then stops when no light follows. A familiar companion might resume beside the place where the player sets down their pack. The repetition carries continuity through evolution without asserting new feeding biology, a lost human soul or the power to restore a dead plant.

Proposed continuity at the same bank: after evolution, the individual pauses beside the old sheltering stone and makes its familiar turn before following the player. A companion can keep that recognizable preference without needing soil packed around an insubstantial body. A former place of care still matters when the act that once helped there is no longer useful.
